rca of the issue: iteration-2 pdf_utils.py change updated only the title string of build_agent_contract_pdf (line 53) but left the section-2 through section-6 Paragraph() blocks unchanged from iteration-1. E1 likely edited only the title and assumed sections propagated. Reproduction: log in as admin, GET /api/contracts/<agent_contract_id>/pdf, extract text — you will see the phrase 'Escrow Amount = 0.06 × (Gross Commission − Broker Fee)' and 'Six Percent (6%) of Net Commission' with zero occurrences of 'home warranty' or 'agent's own commission'. Mitigation: rewrite sections 2-6 of build_agent_contract_pdf to mirror the language pattern already applied to build_client_contract_pdf sections 2-3 (which do mention 'marketing fee equal to six percent (6%) of the agent's own commission' and 'one-year home warranty').
